brief.prompt:
[初回生成]
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1792x1024 or 1920x1080, minimum width 1000px. Full-bleed opaque PNG.

Visual direction: follow the approved black-and-lime basketball editorial samples visible in the conversation: near-black #151A18, vivid lime #CCF43B, off-white, expressive hand-drawn ink and dry brush, strong Japanese typography, few elements, professional crisp thumbnail readability. Do NOT copy any names, statistics, dates or players from those style examples.

The ONLY person is the real professional basketball player 西田公陽 / Koyo Nishida, randomly chosen from players named in the fixed article. Use the official Tokushima profile portrait just inspected in this conversation as identity reference (https://gambarous.jp/files/user/16-NISHIDA.jpg, profile https://gambarous.jp/team/players/detail/id=52350?PlayerID=51000362). Likeness details: Japanese young adult man, athletic sturdy shoulders, clean shaven, elongated oval face with a fairly broad jaw and small rounded chin, straight full eyebrows, almond dark eyes, straight medium-width nose, closed medium lips, slightly prominent ears. Short dark brown hair, sides close and top longer, parted slightly off center with swept curved fringe and a small forehead opening, as in the official portrait. Clearly hand-drawn, with light skin shown in ivory, confident ink contours and angular brush shadows, sufficiently detailed face for likeness. Not a generic invented player, no photorealism, no pasted photograph.

Composition: put Nishida dynamically on the LEFT 43% of the frame in a low forward driving stance, three-quarter view toward the right, from head down to upper shins, holding an orange basketball in his right hand during a crossover gather at waist height; his left hand naturally balances the movement. Face unobscured. Anatomically correct two arms and hands, no extra fingers; show ball completely inside frame. Use a plain monochrome ivory-and-black sleeveless basketball uniform with subtle lime trim, absolutely no logos, no team/sponsor words, no player number or name. Energetic diagonal lime brush strokes behind the figure; abstract near-black background, no arena signage, scoreboard, identifiable opponent or hoop. The pose is a general basketball illustration, NOT a reconstruction of any real game moment.

RIGHT 57% is a clean spacious typography block, with strong alignment and generous safe margins. Render ONLY the following Japanese text, perfectly accurate and clearly separated:
small brand at upper right: 「バスケまとめ」
large date below brand: 「11/16」
very large bold off-white headline: 「試合結果」
prominent off-white qualifier: 「公式記録の」
equally prominent large lime qualifier: 「確定待ち」
smaller supporting line below: 「2026.11.16 19:08 JST時点」
bottom footer, clearly legible off-white and safely inset: 「イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ」

Exact factual scope: the fixed manuscript is titled 11/16 試合結果（公式記録の確定待ち） and states all results and daily EFF rankings await confirmation as of 2026-11-16 19:08 JST. The words 公式記録の確定待ち must be prominent, not hidden in fine print. Do not add a score, ranking, EFF figure, winner, selected player's name, appearance claim, achievement, or any other wording. The player was randomly selected and does not represent confirmed participation or performance. Do not write 成績をもとにしたイメージ; use only イメージ. No team logo, league logo, brand marks, photography, fake paper UI, additional captions, watermarks. Keep all text, head, ball and hands well within safe margins. Aim for polished bold Japanese sports media artwork with lively brushwork and simple readable information hierarchy.

[修正1回・最終採用]
Edit the first image (the finished black/lime Japanese thumbnail) once. The second image is ONLY the official identity reference portrait of Koyo Nishida (西田公陽), not an edit target and never to be pasted.

Keep the entire right-side typography block, every Japanese character, all dates/numbers, exact colors and the hand-drawn ink/brush art style unchanged. The text must remain:
バスケまとめ
11/16
試合結果
公式記録の
確定待ち
2026.11.16 19:08 JST時点
イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ

Fix the illustration framing on the LEFT: scale the complete player-and-ball illustration down around 10–12% and move it inward so ALL of his hair, head, both hands including every fingertip, and the entire basketball are inside the canvas with at least 35px clear safe space at the top and left edges. The lower legs/shorts can crop at bottom as an intentional composition, but head, hands and ball must not touch or cross edges. Keep the low athletic drive, two anatomically correct arms, natural five-finger hands and orange ball. Use the recovered upper/left space for abstract black and lime brush texture.

Refine the face slightly toward the second official portrait: Koyo Nishida's clean-shaven elongated oval face with fuller cheeks, straight eyebrows, almond eyes, straighter nose and medium lips; short dark-brown hair closer at sides with off-center swept part. Preserve likeness as a clearly hand-drawn adult Japanese athlete, not a generic manga character, no photorealism. Plain ivory/black basketball uniform with lime trim; no name, number, team logo, sponsor marks or new text. Do not depict any other person. This remains an illustrative image, not a recreation of an actual game. Keep the landscape 16:9 canvas and resolution.
